先猜一猜，再动手: Make a guess, then try it
画面和真实大小、时间不成比例。: Sizes and times in the picture are not to scale.
换个条件，再看一次: Change a condition and look again
让水从山坡流下来，看看它怎样绕开石头，又怎样改变河岸。: Send water downhill. Watch it pass rocks and reshape the banks.
水往低处走，河道也会慢慢变。: Water travels downhill, and channels slowly change.
河流的路线受地形、岩石、河岸材料、流量和泥沙共同影响。外弯侵蚀、内弯沉积是常见的: River paths depend on terrain, rock, bank material, flow and sediment. Outer-bank erosion and inner-bank deposition are common meander features. Real flow is three-dimensional; this page neither solves turbulence nor predicts an actual channel.
画面把俯视地形展开，并用高处与低处的标记表示坡度。泥沙和河岸变化明显加快，只表示: The landscape is shown from above; high and low markers indicate its slope. Sediment movement and bank changes are greatly accelerated to show the direction of change.
水受到重力作用，从较高的地方流向较低的地方。地面并不平整，水会沿较容易通过的低处: Gravity carries water from higher ground to lower ground. Uneven land guides it along lower, easier paths.
石头挡住了一部分水，水流会从旁边绕过去。试着把石头放到另一个位置，看路线怎样改变: A rock blocks part of the flow, so water passes around it. Move the rock and compare the routes.
流动的水能够冲刷和搬运泥沙。在弯曲的河道中，外侧河岸往往更容易受到冲刷。: Moving water can erode and carry sediment. In a curved channel, the outer bank is often eroded more strongly.
水流慢下来的地方，一部分泥沙会沉积。很多次冲刷和沉积，可以让河道慢慢移动；不是所: Some sediment settles where flow slows. Repeated erosion and deposition can shift a channel over time. Not every river bend begins with a rock.
同一批泥沙：从外岸出发，停在内侧: The same grains leave the outer bank and settle along the inside
上游在画面上方，下游在下方；外侧冲刷、内侧沉积: Upstream is above, downstream below; erosion outside, deposition inside
